# sigma_connections (Data Source)

Lists Sigma connections.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_connections" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `connections` (Attributes List) Connections visible to the caller. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `description_json` (String) Description JSON returned by Sigma.
- `id` (String) Connection ID.
- `name` (String) Connection name.
- `pool_sizes_json` (String) Pool sizes JSON returned by Sigma.
- `timeout_secs` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds.
- `type` (String) Warehouse type.
- `use_friendly_names` (Boolean) Whether friendly names are enabled.
